info.name: Kindly API
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for the Kindly volunteer platform (NestJS + TypeORM + PostgreSQL). Covers authentication, user and role management, taxonomy catalogs, organizations, volunteers, causes and supplies, discovery and match feeds, participations and QR attendance, announcements, and achievements.
